commentary: DCE iron ore futures rose by 1.94 % today, the main contract closed 710.5. The traders' willingness to ship is general .The steel mills are purchase on demand. The overall trading senƟment of the market is general. PBF at Shandong port dealt 707-717 yuan/mt,increase 7-12 yuan/ mt. PBF at Tangshan port dealt 725 yuan/mt,increase 20 yuan/mt; SSF at Tangshan port dealt 600 yuan/mt, increase 20 yuan/mt. Recent public health easing and 16 new policies to prop up the housing market have boosted market conﬁdence, with futures trading sharply higher. On a fundamental basis, SMM's global iron ore shipments totalled 29.6 million tonnes, down 5.8 per cent month-on-month. Among them, Australia sent 12.32 million tons to China, a decrease of 22.9% from the previous month; Brazil shipped 3.33 million tons to China, up 22% month-on- month. And the recent steel plant producƟon plan is frequent, or there is a certain demand for raw material replenishment. Considering the impact of the news or not have conƟnuity, it is expected that in the short term, the ﬁrst emoƟonal consumpƟon and then the logic of the price return to the fundamentals, the recent iron ore price will conƟnue to run a wide range of shocks.
